This plugin bundles:
- MediaPipe Tasks Vision (@mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0.1), Apache License 2.0, Copyright Google LLC. https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
- 3d-force-graph 1.80.0, MIT License, Copyright Vasco Asturiano. https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph
- three-spritetext 1.10.0, MIT License, Copyright Vasco Asturiano. https://github.com/vasturiano/three-spritetext
- three.js 0.186, MIT License, Copyright three.js authors. https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js
The MediaPipe hand landmarker model is downloaded at runtime from Google and is covered by Google's terms for MediaPipe models.
Full license texts accompany the bundled code at the end of main.js and on the project pages above.
bridge.js (the browser camera page script) bundles MediaPipe Tasks Vision under the same Apache License 2.0.
